game.summary: Restored match-online-fixes-001's snapshot (ac3a5e8, owned paths only; git diff --stat against it was empty before edits) and fixed the three findings. (1) docs/match-online-coverage.md: 285 rows (265 tested, 15 equivalent, 5 removed), no unreachable or untested rows. Each tested row was produced by deleting the branch on a scratch copy and running its tests; the row names the failing tests and the deletion id. Surviving deletions got new tests (lobby grapple before control start, claim input stall, no claim while respawning, start-rate window, world seed, end removes the duel marker, results synced once, claimTotal, unit edge cases) or an equivalent/removed row with its reason. (2) apps/server/src/flowReports.ts knownFlowReports (the only unknown-id filter before stepMatch; reportAccomplishments' own filter is folded into it) with unit tests for every drop, and a room-level ghost-id test (tests/integration/flowReports.test.ts, via a new testHooks-gated injectFlowReports). The join-refused backstop is removed as dead code, with the proof in the table. (3) Pure view models flowView/applyFlow (flowHud.ts), treasureView (treasureView.ts, used by seaScene.drawTreasure), flowModelOf/claimingShipsOf/showStartRefusal/showReveal (moved out of main.ts), all unit-tested. New browser scenario match-deadline (tests/e2e/matchDeadline.spec.ts): a 20 s match via a new test-only route, POST /__test/next-match-timings (next match only, served only with test placement, 404 on production per the smoke build). The compass now shows inactive ('No treasure route yet') in play when no route is known. The dev.ts env mapping moved to testSettings.ts (unit-tested). Final checks run in the worktree: npm run typecheck, test:unit (1265 passed), build, test:integration (106 passed, 177 s), and the full playwright suite with the JSON report (11 passed); check-report said every scenario (all 10) is ok. The npm ci at the start passed. Nothing committed.
open_assumptions: 'The compass is shown inactive while no route is known' is read as: during play the compass is visible with data-state=none, data-active=false and 'No treasure route yet' text (hidden in the lobby, ready check and results). This changed one existing full-match assertion (guest compass toBeHidden) to data-state none / data-active false / arrow hidden.
The join-refused backstop and two other dead branches were removed, not tested; the table gives the proof for each.
The browser server's short match for match-deadline comes from the new test-only POST /__test/next-match-timings route (not a protocol message), so no protocol version bump.
